testsuite.name: org.mozilla.fenix.lw.UpdateCheckerTest

testcase.name: the version code decides when both sides have one
a correctly signed document naming a newer version is offered
the running version is up to date
version comparison is numeric and component-wise
a missing signature or document is a no-result
a document signed by another key is a no-result, not an update
without a version code in the document the version strings decide
a tampered document is a no-result
an http download url is rejected even when signed
the request sends no Accept-Language, so not the user's locale
a coded document is never offered to an install that cannot read its own code
the request carries the static user agent and nothing else
